instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a bright indoor workshop, the man with the afro (R2) in a gray button-down shirt stands on the left, looking down as he lifts a cardboard tube container off a wooden table. On the right, the man in the rust-red turtleneck and green apron (R3) stands opposite him, leaning forward slightly with his left hand on the table, watching with a smile. A laptop and colorful glass vases are visible on the left side of the table. Natural light from a window illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
elements: R2 lifts a cardboard tube container off a wooden table
R3 watches R2 with a smile rather than lifting the container himself
R3 leans forward with his left hand on the table while observing
